reasons.authored-starter: A starter holds nothing but what its person places in it and costs nothing to make, so the policy does not count starters.
reasons.generated: A CHOSEN BUDGET, not a measured cost. Holding a generated world costs rows only; what grows with worlds held is the Your worlds page, which reads and draws every card at once. A signed-in person's workspace may hold 24 and a guest's 6; a deployment states its own figures in the environment variables named here. No route removes a world yet, so worlds held times the recipes' tile maximum (exulanica/world/world_recipes.py, TILES_MAXIMUM) still bounds every bake a workspace can ever cause.
reasons.personal-source: One world is composed from a workspace's own photographs and other personal sources: code that means that world resolves it from the registry, and a second is another version of this policy.
reasons.tiles_a_day: A CHOSEN BUDGET over the cost the earlier limit of three stood for: tile bakes. A workspace may make generated worlds whose tiles, counted from each world's receipt over the last 24 hours, come to at most 48 for a signed-in person (twelve four-tile towns) and 12 for a guest (six two-tile towns). Every tile of a world made is counted, baked already or not, and a world counts whether or not it is later removed, so removing and making again cannot reopen the bound. The figures are chosen, not measured: one bake of the one-tile town took 13.3 s on the development machine, and a measurement of bake seconds and stored bytes a tile, for each recipe, replaces them.
